# art-empty



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Empty — shadcn/ui parity. A centred empty state: media (an icon in a muted box, an image),
title, description and content (actions, a search field).

## Slots

| Slot            | Description                                                 |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
|                 | Actions or other content under the header.                  |
| `"description"` | Supporting text.                                            |
| `"media"`       | `<art-icon slot="media" size="lg">` (boxed) or any element. |
| `"title"`       | The heading.                                                |


## Shadow Parts

| Part        | Description                   |
| ----------- | ----------------------------- |
| `"content"` | The default slot wrapper.     |
| `"empty"`   | The wrapper.                  |
| `"header"`  | Media, title and description. |
